title: The Twin-Court Canon of the Compounding Line
summary: A canon of paired blows that pile onto one line so that each stroke weighs more than the sum of those before it.

title: The Dual-Track Manual of Unending Reach
summary: A manual that runs two lines of qi on two tracks and lets each lengthen without a stop until they close upon the mark.

title: A Basin-and-River Treatise on the Unfailing Flow
summary: A treatise on a flow of restoring qi that is fed from a basin with no bottom and mends and calls back without pause.

title: The Wind-Sworn Book of the Unceasing Run
summary: A book of the wind-sworn run that keeps its pace without a drop and carries the runner on to strike again and again.

title: The Oath of the Boundless Bearing
summary: A manual of oaths that renew themselves with every kept promise so that a sworn effort grows stronger with time.

title: A Gale Canon of the Unwalled Reserve
summary: A canon of the open reserve that has no wall and no floor and feeds the user and the near ally from a deep and endless well.
